prompt_text: I want to sell my house in Pleasanton. Which specific real estate agents should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but first a couple quick clarifying questions so I give you the best, most relevant agent picks:

1. By “Pleasanton” do you mean Pleasanton, CA (Alameda County)?  
2. What’s your home type and estimated price range (single-family, townhome/condo, 3bd/2ba, luxury >$1.5M, etc.)?  
3. What matters most to you in an agent: highest price, fastest sale, lowest commission, concierge/staging services, experience with relocations, bilingual, or something else?  
4. Do you want me to look up current local agent rankings, recent sales and contact info (I can pull a short vetted list)?

If you want me to proceed without extra details, I can still give immediate, practical guidance now and then look up specific names when you confirm.

Immediate, actionable plan (so you can start calling right away)
- Interview 3 agents: 1 high-volume/team (lots of buyers and marketing), 1 local neighborhood specialist (knows Pleasanton micro-markets), and 1 boutique/luxury or staging-focused agent if your price point is higher or you want concierge services.  
- Contact the local offices of these brokerages (they can recommend their top Pleasanton agents): Compass, Keller Williams (Tri-Valley), Intero Real Estate, Coldwell Banker, and Sereno Group. These brokerages have active teams in Pleasanton and the Tri-Valley area.

What to ask when you call/interview (keeps comparisons objective)
- How many Pleasanton homes have you sold in the last 12 months? Can you share 2–3 recent comparable listings and sales?  
- What is your recommended list price range and strategy to get to that price?  
- What’s your marketing plan (professional photos, video, targeted online ads, open houses, agent network)?  
- Who will be my day-to-day contact — you or an assistant/team member?  
- What is your commission and any additional fees (staging, photography, lockbox)? Are fees negotiable?  
- Typical days on market you’re seeing in Pleasanton for homes like mine?  
- Can you provide references from recent sellers in my neighborhood?

How I choose which specific agents to recommend (so you know my criteria)
- Recent closed sales in Pleasanton (last 6–12 months) and sale-to-list ratio.  
- Local market knowledge of your neighborhood/complex.  
- Marketing capability (professional photography, online reach, staging services).  
- Responsiveness and seller references.  
- Fit with your priorities (price vs speed, commission sensitivity, concierge services).

If you want, I will:
- Look up current top-performing Pleasanton agents and produce a short list (3–5 agents) with phone numbers, recent comparable solds, and a recommended primary pick plus backups.  
Tell me whether you want me to search now and confirm the city/price range/preferences above.
